description: Sparkle before 2.9.6 contains a time-of-check time-of-use race condition in the installer's SPUInstallationData handling in AppInstaller.m, which validates the symlink-resolved download URL but performs the privileged move on the unresolved URL and checks the file type only afterwards. A local user can swap an intermediate directory of the download path for a symlink between the check and the move, causing a root installer to rename a file out of a protected location and leading to privilege escalation when the installer runs in the system domain.
